name: youtube-research
description: Keyless YouTube research for agents: multi-language search with transcript highlights, transcript ranges, real video frames, chapters, comments and channel outliers, plus a research orchestration skill.

interface.shortDescription: Let your agent research YouTube: search, transcripts, frames, outliers. No API key.
interface.longDescription: Search YouTube in several languages in one call and get transcript highlights with timestamped links, read only the slice of a video you need (time range, chapter or matching passages), see real video frames, find a channel's breakout videos, and follow a research skill that plans queries, fans out to subagents and cites every claim. No API key or cookies.
defaultPrompt: List 10 hooks from YouTube videos about AI productivity, in English and Czech, with hook type and timestamped links.
